rows.notes: Scene: Picnic lawn. Major Wood faces the camera, ready to move. In the same shot: a kite. At the same moment, a kite soars and loops across a clear blue sky, ending with Major Wood looking straight into the camera with a big confident grin. Payoff: Kite snapping taut in a strong gust of wind, sharp fabric crack with a fluttering tail, close-mic, cinematic foley.
